# Email to specialist TCG stores: "welcome our stock monitor"

Send from hello@tcgtracker.com.au to stores on the coverage page (/drops/stores/) whose status is "Not reachable" or that our monitor finds rate-limited. Personalise the first line.

---

**Subject:** Sending Pokémon & One Piece buyers to {Store name}: quick question

Hi {Name / team},

I run TCGTracker (https://tcgtracker.com.au), an Australian site that alerts collectors when Pokémon and One Piece sealed product lands in stock, and sends them straight to the store's own product page to buy it.

We'd like to include {Store name} in our live stock alerts. Our monitor is small and polite. It identifies itself as `TCGTrackerBot` (details at https://tcgtracker.com.au/about/bot/), reads only your public product listings about once every few minutes, honours robots.txt, and never adds to cart or checks out.

Your site currently {rate-limits / blocks} automated requests, so we can't list your stock. Would you be open to one of these?

1. Allowing `TCGTrackerBot` on your public catalogue (your platform's bot settings, or allow-listing our server's IP, which we can send you), or
2. Sharing a product feed or affiliate programme link, if you have one.

Either way, every alert links directly to your listing at your price. We don't resell, and we're happy to list you as a partner store on our site.

Thanks,
Jamie
TCGTracker · tcgtracker.com.au
